之前新品节试玩后就加愿望单啦！想着20块交个朋友！[strike]首发24小时内免费入库好耶！看到评测的大家快领啊！！[/strike] 像这种肉鸽收集类的游戏最喜欢啦！虽然卡萝小姐是个手残！总是让人怀念起小时候自创道具画战斗堡垒的时光！ 联机可以创建公开房间，最多四人，如果玩家没满会有人机补充！ 进本前能预览地图，地图里有搬蛋小任务（不知道是被怪打碎了还是啥最后没完成），还有生存60秒的战斗房记得带弹药箱进去会缺子弹！ 不同角色有不同的成长特点，还有搭配各种武器的构筑，解锁新角色-通关-解锁新武器-新武器还会给之前通关过的角色新体验，这样一个良性循环可以持续很久，作为小游戏物超所值！ 简单，极致，没事拉上小伙伴一起战斗爽！！！
考虑了很久，终于花0元全款拿下，感觉没有分期的必要！ 在二十几岁的年纪，经济独立，不靠父母，全靠刷小黑盒刷到的，未来可期，加油！

先说结论，目前的武器平衡状态完全不推荐。 继承了DEMO版本里面大部分幽默武器数值的同时又砍了比较有用的升级，鉴定为一坨。 初始的数把武器在测试版中基本上只有短管喷因其扩散较大才具有极强的清潮能力，在正式版中移除了射程增加和我不记得有没有的穿透属性之后强度也大幅下降，射程短的批爆，如果像测试版那样点扩散的话基本上就是弹丸雨露均沾之谁也打不死。 1.现有的大部分基础实弹武器因为无AOE无穿透属性的原因基本上就是靠龙息或者其他元素弹药来补伤慢慢磨死，短管龙息的AOE效果较为出众，但其他连射武器基本上因为幽默弹药量/伤害加上无穿透的属性基本上很难持续压潮，就算拿下击杀爆炸的情况下也基本上都是只能打小小登引发小连锁，清怪效率捉急。 尤其要喷的就是冲锋枪和机枪的幽默备弹和伤害，别说199，在你游高难情况下个人感觉甚至299，399的初始弹药可能都不够打过两波潮，如果难度因子选了来潮速度加倍的话旅途中前期关卡初始数量的弹药几乎可以在几十秒内完全打空，再加上随着波次逐渐强化的敌人血量，可以说是毫无强度可言。 2.左右脑互搏的长度设计，本作基于肉鸽属性的双向增强系统很明显做的非常失衡，你面对的敌人每一波都在增强，而你的武器则未必赶得上敌人增加的强度，尤其是全场升级和商店都在给你雪中送屎的时候更是有种纯真的美。 在加长因子的影响之下不是单个种类的敌人拉满全部buff就是雨露均沾之除了你那点蚊子腿升级以外敌人都有增强，在此基础之上是稀少武器弹药和因为经常出现构式升级而面露难色的你，因为大部分武器的强度其实都处于大便王中王的水平，所以真正值得选择的武器也少得可怜，如果你是野队的话那配合水平玩起来更是屎上雕花。 突击兵手雷设计的也很有问题，碰到怪直接变成碰炸雷，在敌人大量聚集的情况下经常无法丢到怪堆中间而是直接炸死前面的一两只，非常的雷普，然后测试了一下那个全部弹药容量加30%的牌也没生效，备弹和弹匣容量都没有变化，商店里面也没刷到过，不知道是bug还是什么鬼物。

作为一款俯视角动作射击游戏，核心玩法围绕“随机探索+组队抗敌”展开，但难度设计实在有些劝退，哪怕是普通难度，刚上手时也几乎没法通关，必须花大量时间在局外升级角色、解锁被动技能，比如提升基础血量、强化武器伤害，才能勉强扛住小怪的围攻；更别提后期的+15难度，没把主力角色养成到满级，连见到BOSS的资格都没有，养成压力实在太大。 游戏里的4个角色倒各有亮点，比如有的能扔盾牌扛伤、有的能召唤无人机辅助输出、还有的自带群体回血，组队时配合起来有战术感，但单人玩时缺了队友补位，容错率直接砍半。地图设计像《Warframe》那样每局随机生成；武器、武器Mod和角色增益也全看运气，有时候能拿到神装，有时候却只能用基础手枪刮痧，运气差时连普通关卡都打得憋屈。 其实游戏的俯视角射击手感不算差，技能释放也流畅，随机元素带来的新鲜感也足，但过高的难度把这些优点都盖过了，很容易失去耐心。要是能把整体难度降低一半，既能保留“需要策略和养成”的挑战性，又不会让玩家卡在前期反复坐牢，体验会舒服太多。 总的来说，这游戏更适合喜欢硬核养成、愿意花时间磨进度的玩家，新手或想轻松体验射击爽感的玩家，大概率会被前期的高难度劝退。

这是我近期玩过的最难受的rogue游戏了，很后悔入手，没入手的千万别入。有几个很严重的问题： 1.很难。在没有升级人物等级的情况下，第一关都很难过。难在几个方面：（1）子弹太少。想用全自动的武器，基本上三波敌人就能把备弹打完，经常捡不到子弹包，变成拿个小手枪一直刮痧；（2）回血的方式太少。只有药包能回血，药包只能靠捡，或者在商店里买，生存压力极大。想兼顾子弹和药包？不可能的，只有两个自由格子；（3）前期就有几个很恶心的精英小怪，比如远程吐毒液的这个SB，会来回走位躲枪线，隔老远吐你一口，瞬间掉40血，如果出现在地图上，你不马上清掉，很大概率会死，太几把SB了。 2.游戏内的成长性太弱，长流程关卡设定下显得很无聊。很大一部分rogue玩家的爽点就是在游戏内的频繁个体成长，这游戏小关和小关之间如果没有商店，只能靠捡的箱子在关卡结束后开启，给几个聊胜于无的属性加成，而在战斗过程中是没有任何可以成长的手段的。综合来说就是不仅给的频率少，每次给的数值还少（比如+5%移速我拿来干嘛用），没商店就等着坐牢吧，真的可以把人打困了。哦对了，不少加成还伴随了其他的负面效果。 3.大厅的美化设施拿来干嘛用的？线条风格的rogue游戏，你让我给你肝装修？wqnmlgb 4.游戏内容太少，感觉是没做完的游戏。总共就几大关，偏偏我还看不出来每一关有啥不一样。

（以下均为游玩单人游戏后的感受，并未游玩过多人模式} 第一点，游戏开始并没有任何的新手引导，对于游戏的进程与任务目标也是没有丝毫的解释，一上来给玩家的观感就不好。我既不知道这个游戏的相关背景，也不知道我要去干什么，我在基地里能干什么，让人一头雾水。 第二点，说是rouge类游戏，实际上相关的元素更是少得可怜，局内能使用的武器从入场开始便被固定，说是rouge，其实只是堆砌相关的模组升级，只能带来相关数值上的变化，玩法单一乏味。同时局内枪械的射击和走路冲刺的手感都非常奇怪（当然这可能只是我个人的感觉），人物ui的设计我自己是不满意的。 总体上给我的感觉就像是一个半成品，被急着端上市场，创新性与乐趣全都不足，当前版本不建议购买，不知道后续如何。

Concept-wise: This game has no soul. It has too many ideas and themes it tries to go for and no clear and distinctive identity to it: play wo music on and it's kinda eery -- but not really; if you think about the characters fighting through massive waves of mutants L4D style and you listen to the swarm OST it's kinda badass -- but not really; if you notice everything is cartoony and sausage-like it's kinda goofy -- but not really; overall it has 5 or 7 distinctive features to it which have already been explored in thousands of other roguelike games, better than how GUNTOUCHABLES handled it. The voice-lines are ok at first but get very repetitive and annoying (especially the swarm announcer), very quickly. Gameplay-wise: There are some nice novel elements to it, primarily the missions not taking necessarily 30 minutes and the cost-payoff balance of choosing modifiers at the end of a mission -- but let's talk face to face, the latter has been adopted by so many games by now, it's kind of a base requirement for multi-floor action games w inter-floor rewards (and if you do not implement them, you're js another TBoI); the former is not unique to GUNTOUCHABLES and I probably appreciated it more because I'm used to TBoI and DRG. Everything else about the gameplay is basic. Nothing extraordinary or interesting. Finally -- although this is not a critique to the devs necessarily, since it's a very personal point -- co-op doesn't work, it's just skill in avoiding enemies and managing crowds -- which is a difficult thing to do tbf, but has no strategic element to it (whereas in singleplayer anyone could AT LEAST plan out which upgrades to get. In principle it should be doable in coop as well, but it just doesn't happen unless you want to stop and type a 300 characters message to your teammates) and it's not really a co-op only thing: even in singleplayer you have to dodge enemies and bullets and whatnot. Progression of the game-wise: Achievements are doable with a decent amount of playtime -- which is appreciated -- but getting cans to buy all cosmetics is a bit too much, primarily because the payoff per mission is very little (yes, even IF you were to play an heat 50 mission although that's almost impossible). I think the percentages have to be changed, which also brings me to my final critique to the game. Updates: The trinkets and the elite enemies were nice and refreshing but I feel they could've very well been included at release time. They were not that big of a deal if not to optimize gameplay styles. Also I can't see, how elite bile runners have not been debuffed nor why we're not getting as many bug fixes as many there are reported on the discord server. Development and release seems to be a bit too slow. Community: It does sadden me to see no one cared too much about this title. Before 1.3.0 there were at most 2 servers open at any given time and they were new players trying it. Wikis are absent, the only game mechanics I know either come from personal experience or that one guide about all upgrades, which is not being updated anymore because the author was the only guy that seemed to care about it. Something definitely went not as planned either when making or publishing this game, because a. is not good, it's basic b. no one -- like, actually no one -- showed interest about it even though it had the GSG label on it and it released with a pretty important 100% discount, which would have anyone think everyone was going to play it. If the team behind Game Swing is made of new game developers, I am sorry this was the treatment it got. I'm attaching my laptop's spec just to let you know it runs fine -- although a bit laggy at times, but nothing to brag about.

Maybe I haven't played enough but this game seemed much more promising than it is. Firstly it's not really an original idea for a game and it's not very well executed, the attacks feel quite weak and thin, and the UI and menus are more confusing and overcomplicated than they should. The graphics are actually really good and I love the style, it's something that definitely drew me to this game. Performance is great but again, while the STYLE is good, the attacks just feel really thin, the sound design isn't crunchy enough, and it doesn't feel as satisfying as a fast-paced roguelike should be. It's also got more walking than necessary. I really wish I could say different, this game has huge potential but it's just not something I could find myself getting into or investing some time into. It's just not as fun as it looks. If the attacks were more fleshed out and there was some more originality and fun to the upgrades, I'd totally try again. Also the aiming mechanic is weird as it's a top-down shooter, so you'd expect to have 360 rotation around your player pointing to where your mouse is, but you're locked to these 10 degree or so increments around you instead of smooth rotation which is completely fine gameplay wise as it's enough to aim properly but still takes from the satisfaction and I found it to be a bit weird. Overall, love the style, just wish the gameplay was a bit more fleshed out and cleaner feeling.

GUNTOUCHABLES is pure dumb fun in the best possible way. The game throws endless hordes of enemies at you while you run around blasting everything on screen with increasingly ridiculous weapons and upgrades. It’s fast, chaotic, and clearly inspired by games like Vampire Survivors, but with way more guns, explosions, and nonsense happening at all times. The biggest strength of the game is how satisfying it feels once your build starts coming together. Early on you’re barely surviving, but later your screen turns into complete madness filled with bullets, fire, explosions, and enemies evaporating instantly. The good: - Extremely addictive gameplay loop - Tons of weapons and upgrades - Chaos becomes hilarious later into runs - Satisfying progression during matches - Easy to learn and instantly fun - Great “one more run” feeling - Fast-paced gameplay with almost no downtime - Build variety keeps runs interesting - Perfect game for short sessions The bad: - Gameplay can become repetitive after long sessions - Visual clutter gets insane later on - Balance between weapons/upgrades isn’t perfect - Some runs depend heavily on RNG - Not much depth outside the core gameplay loop - Limited enemy variety - Performance can dip when the screen gets too crowded - Can feel grindy when unlocking content Overall, GUNTOUCHABLES knows exactly what it wants to be - a chaotic, over-the-top survivor shooter where the goal is to become an unstoppable bullet-spewing monster. It’s simple, addictive, and very hard to stop playing once a run gets going.

This is an inexplicably almost popular console tier top down twin stick shooter with procgen content and a multiplayer focus. The game features "progression" and various character builds from unlocking various abilities. The low quality technical presentation, despite being polished (making that polish look like lipstick on a pig) is underwhelming, but the real killer is just the ho-hum nature of endless procgen, repetition, and uninspired character building that leaves an overwhelming sense of "What's the point". I think, having said that, and despite all the drawbacks, this might have been successful on the consoles it was apparently designed for. But, Sony, Micorosft and Nintendo have QA departments. Valve has Steam Direct. On the upside, the game does feature customisable controls and resolution, so at least some of the basic, minimum requirements have been met. Unfortunately there's a number of other technical defects and shortcomings which contribute to the game being difficult to recommend to gamers. This looks a lot like it was designed for consoles, but released on Steam instead by mistake. While this is on PC, it has all the hallmarks and deficiencies of a console game, from the clunkier than needed control scheme to the less than cutting edge graphics. There's 10's of thousands of PC games on Steam, and PC gamers deserve only the best. This might not appeal to many gamers due to the lack of PC-centric design. It's unclear why this never made it to the video game console appliances it seems to have been designed for. The game features lazy low-polygon "retro" assets, making this look like a barely functional 3D game from the 1990s. It's unclear why the developers weren't able to arrange high quality, high polygon count contemporary assets for the game, and also irrelevant... what matters is that this looks bad as a result of their decisions, a compromise PC gamers shouldn't have to put up with. The game features no proper level design or game/story flow/plot, as they opted to try to use samey repetitive procgen algorithms as a substitute for adding such content to the game, to avoid doing the important job of level/map design. As a result, the game doesn't actually have any content worth mentioning, just endless, boring, repetitive, soulless algorithmically generated sameyness. Developers must learn that procedural generation is not an acceptable substitute for content. These flaws make this game fall far short of the professional standards we expect from a modern PC game. Now on to pricing and value for gamers. So, should you buy this game? Is this one of the best of the 140,000+ games on Steam? GUNTOUCHABLES has the greedy, cash grab price of around $5 USD, it's not worth it given the defects and shortcomings with the product, especially considering the sheer number of completely free, much higher quality games on Steam. For comparison, the $5 asking price for this game could get you games like "Planet Coaster", "Rainbow 6 Siege" or "Sleeping Dogs". Quality, professionally made games like those are frequently on sale cheaper than this. They also nag you quite a lot to buy the $5 supporter pack, which is annoying. The quality problems and defects with this game makes the asking price totally unrealistic. It's impossible to recommend this to gamers here on Steam.
